ValidationRule.description: The Fields are required in Stage 2 for NPI Opportunity
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Existing Customer / add-on order")), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "2 - Requirement Definition/Technical Evl"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "3 - Technical Qualification/Approval"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "4 - Commercial Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "5 - Business Award – Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "6 - Production Order on Backlog"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost"), CONTAINS(TEXT(StageName), "Other") ), OR( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "NPI_Opportunity", $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Semi_Opportunity" ), OR( ISBLANK(Full_Production_Annual_Value__c), ISBLANK(Revenue_Forecast_Year_1__c), ISBLANK(Revenue_Forecast_Year_2__c), ISBLANK(Revenue_Forecast_Year_3__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete all value fields before advancing to Stage 2 on an NPI opportunity. - Full Production Annual Value - Revenue Forecast Year 1 - Revenue Forecast Year 2 - Revenue Forecast Year 3
